claim: Open the Signal Desk sample workspace with three ready-to-render tracks in one click and reset it to the original sample.
where: Landing primary action, demo banner, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-sample-data
sandbox: Fresh 390 px browser context; click the landing action, assert the banner, Signal Desk workspace, and named first track are in the first viewport; then open /?demo=1 and assert its banner, controls, three tracks, and reset result.

claim: Demo data is separate from real Wrapline data and is discarded when leaving the demo.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolation
sandbox: Save a real recipe, enter /demo, assert the demo database and sample, leave through Start for real, and assert the real recipe remains.

claim: Rendering sends no audio, analytics, tracker, font, or runtime CDN request outside Wrapline.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-audio
sandbox: Record every request during a fresh /demo render and assert every HTTP request is same-origin.

claim: The installed demo reloads and renders offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-demo
sandbox: Own browser context; install the worker at /demo, verify cached shell bytes, go offline, reload, assert the sample, and render.

claim: Wrapline accepts real WAV and MP3 voice input and renders both.
where: Landing facts, queue picker, terms, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:wav-mp3-input
sandbox: Fresh bench; add a generated PCM WAV and the committed synthetic MP3 fixture, render both, and inspect two non-empty WAV outputs.

claim: A sample batch produces recipe-named, playable WAV files and a receipt download.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:wav-receipt
sandbox: Fresh /demo render; assert three audio previews, exact recipe-derived .wav names, and the ZIP summary.

claim: Wrapline exports playable 48 kHz MP3 at the selected 128 or 192 kbps constant bitrate.
where: Landing facts, output controls, loudness disclosure, terms, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:mp3-output
sandbox: Render the demo at each offered bitrate; parse the MP3 frame header, decode the output, and inspect codec, bitrate, and filename in the receipt.

claim: WAV is 48 kHz 16-bit PCM; voice gain is capped at ±12 dB; intro and outro stay unchanged; the music bed ducks 7 dB; peaks stay below −0.18 dBFS.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:audio-behavior
sandbox: Render deterministic tone and silence fixtures; inspect PCM regions and receipts for wrapper level, ducking ratio, gain caps, peak ceiling, sample rate, and bit depth.

claim: Each receipt records recipe version, source SHA-256, output name, duration, gain, limiter state, codec, and measurement method.
where: Recent receipts section, privacy policy, README
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:source-receipt
sandbox: Render a known WAV, download its receipt, compare the SHA-256, and assert every named production field.

claim: Saved recipes, intro audio, and receipts persist in local browser storage.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-recipes
sandbox: Save a recipe and intro WAV, render a receipt, reload, and assert the recipe, audio name, and receipt remain.

claim: The free tier saves one recipe and renders up to three tracks per batch.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:free-tier
sandbox: Block verification, attempt a second recipe and a four-track render, and assert both free limits remain enforced.

claim: Studio is a $29 one-time license with a labeled external Sociobot checkout at the product-scoped URL.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:studio-license
sandbox: Fresh /demo; assert the visible $29 one-time external-checkout label and exact registered product checkout URL without following it.

claim: A valid Studio response permits unlimited saved recipes and tracks per batch.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:studio-unlimited
sandbox: Use a recorded valid response, save two recipes, render four tracks, and assert all outputs.

claim: A completed license check for the same token is reused for one day.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:license-daily-check
sandbox: Submit the same token twice against a recorded invalid response and assert exactly one verification request.

claim: License verification sends only the token to the product verification URL and an invalid response stays locked.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:license-boundary
sandbox: Capture the verification request, assert its exact encoded token URL and local fields, return revoked, and assert free mode remains active.

claim: A saved recipe can be exported with its audio files and deleted from the device.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:recipe-controls
sandbox: Save a recipe with a WAV intro, inspect the downloaded JSON and embedded audio, confirm deletion, reload, and assert it is gone.

claim: Landing, demo, privacy, terms, and not-found routes have route-specific metadata, shared legal links, and correct HTTP status.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:route-shell
sandbox: Visit every public route and an unknown path; assert status, title, metadata, landmarks, legal links, build ID, accessibility, and no unexpected console errors.
